TPU QUIC server tile with packet reassembly, metrics, key logging, and network I/O.

# Purpose
`fd_quic_tile.c` implements a TPU server tile that receives transaction traffic over `TPU/QUIC` and `TPU/UDP`, then publishes complete transactions to the downstream verify path. It builds and configures a `fd_quic_t` server, sets QUIC limits, installs callbacks for connection finalization, stream receive, TLS key logging, and packet transmit, and connects the tile to the network and verify output links through the `fd_stem` framework. The file also handles transaction reassembly with `fd_tpu_reasm`, including fast-path publication for complete QUIC streams and legacy handling for single-packet UDP transactions.

The file also contains tile setup and runtime support code. It validates topology links and scratch space, initializes clocks, keys, seccomp rules, and allowed file descriptors, and writes runtime metrics for packet, stream, connection, and reassembly activity. In addition, it manages outgoing network packet construction for QUIC transmit, periodic housekeeping, and round-robin input selection across multiple `quic` tiles.
